name: Para-chlorophenylpiperazine
summary: para-Chlorophenylpiperazine (pCPP) is a psychoactive drug of the phenylpiperazine class. It is relatively obscure, with limited human use, and produces slightly psychedelic effects. It has been encountered in illicit capsules as a recreational drug similarly to other piperazines like mCPP.

pharmacology.text: Scientific research has demonstrated pCPP to have serotonergic effects, likely acting as a non-selective serotonin receptor agonist and/or releasing agent.

uses.text: It has been encountered in illicit capsules as a recreational drug similarly to other piperazines like mCPP.

zhOther: 對氯苯基哌嗪, 對氯苯基呱嗪

sideEffects.en: Human use is limited, so little is known. Piperazines of this kind commonly cause headache, nausea, anxiety, a fast heart rate and poor sleep, and the unpleasant effects often outlast the wanted ones.
sideEffects.zh: 人體使用的經驗有限，因此所知不多。這類哌嗪化合物常造成頭痛、噁心、焦慮、心跳加快與睡眠不佳，而且不適感往往比預期的作用持續更久。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人体使用的经验有限，因此所知不多。这类哌嗪化合物常造成头痛、恶心、焦虑、心跳加快与睡眠不佳，而且不适感往往比预期的作用持续更久。

fact.en: It is a near twin of mCPP, differing only in where the chlorine sits on the ring, and mCPP is itself what the body makes from the antidepressant trazodone.
fact.zh: 它與 mCPP 幾乎是雙胞胎，差別只在氯原子位於環上的位置；而 mCPP 本身是人體由抗憂鬱藥曲唑酮生成的代謝物。
fact.zhHans: 它与 mCPP 几乎是双胞胎，差别只在氯原子位于环上的位置；而 mCPP 本身是人体由抗忧郁药曲唑酮生成的代谢物。
